title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Code 2.1.319: background MCP tasks and a deny-instead-of-prompting permission setting
bullets.summary: Claude Code 2.1.319 adds background MCP tasks, a permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting setting, auto-mode and gateway controls, plus many fixes (per Releasebot's Claude Code feed, first seen Nov 7).
bullets.how: The Construct: denyInsteadOfPrompting is the right mode for unattended scheduled routines (fail closed rather than hang on a prompt), and background MCP tasks suit long-running tool calls. PRAGMA: reusable unattended-agent hardening checklist. Brand 9 Signs: indirect.

bullets.title: Personal Finance in Claude (beta): read-only bank and card connections
bullets.summary: Anthropic launched a beta for US Pro, Max and Ultra users that connects bank and card accounts for read-only spending and balance answers (Nov 5, via Releasebot).
bullets.how: The Construct: shows Anthropic shipping consumer-grade connected-data agents with read-only scoping, a pattern worth copying for our own data connectors. PRAGMA: client-pitch example of read-only-by-default access. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Moonshot releases Kimi K3.1 Pro open weights; Mistral Large 4 and Tencent Hy4 also land
bullets.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro scored 58.6 on a finance-agent benchmark vs 45.0 for GPT-6 Astra per PYMNTS; Mistral Large 4 weights shipped Oct 29 under a modified MIT licence and Tencent launched Hy4 on Nov 4 (open weights promised later). Benchmark claims are as reported, not independently verified.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: credible open-weight options for clients needing self-hosting or lower cost. The Construct: candidate cheap workers for low-risk routine steps behind our own evals. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: OpenAI debuts GPT-6 Cyber with gated access
bullets.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, which it says beats GPT-6 Astra on most cyber tasks, limited initially to approved Daybreak Red customers with wider access expected over coming weeks; it is OpenAI's fourth cyber-focused model this year (Fortune, Nov 5).
bullets.how: Not directly usable (gated). PRAGMA: signals demand for AI-assisted security review in client engagements. The Construct: no action. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Unattended agents need fail-closed defaults: Claude Code's denyInsteadOfPrompting and read-only-by-default connectors (Personal Finance) show the pattern, so configure scheduled routines to deny rather than wait on a prompt, and sell that hardening as part of PRAGMA engagements. (Caveats: sourced from Releasebot and press summaries; no verified signage/CRM/DAM/real-estate MCP news and no fresh xAI/DeepSeek/Cohere/Meta launches or arXiv picks found, so those are omitted.)
